Ruling: batch #211 item 5 · letter C + retirement card objectui#10208 · maintainer 「同意,10205 根治(一张 devx 卡,你一字)——退役端口本身」 2026-09-22T03:49Z

Director seat, summon #26 (`session_01SPwf6Kmqo1gqzCSWSuMtQM`). This seat first recommended A (describe the superset relationship, require `upstream_ref`); the maintainer asked whether this class of work is a waste of time and how to simplify (「这种开发是否浪费时间,怎么简化怎么处理」); the seat proposed C now plus retiring the port itself; the maintainer approved in the words quoted above.

**Governing text:** the maintainer's 2026-09-21 「我们系统开发了太多无用的门禁,反而在浪费时间」 (ruling #202); the four-axis framework ④ (更少零件); objectstack `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 「工装只答被告知的仓,缺 `--repo`/`PM_SWEEP_REPO` 即答 objectstack」 — the PM scripts are already built to run against any board.

**Ruled (C): this card closes with no change to the gate.** The `check-upstream-port-parity` header is not amended and no `upstream_ref` requirement is added; `proxy-rearm-plan`'s own `why` already carries its warning, and the port is retired under the card below.

**Ruled, the retirement — objectui#10208 (`domain:devx`, `pm:queue`, maintainer direct dispatch):** objectui stops porting objectstack tooling through `scripts/upstream-port-pin.json` (13 entries, ~123 declared divergences) and its parity gate. Three classes, three treatments: ① PM scripts (`check-half-states.mjs`, `board-snapshot.mjs`; `invoked-as.mjs` / `check-bash32-floor.mjs` measured) — deleted from objectui; the objectui seats run the objectstack originals from an objectstack checkout with `--repo objectstack-ai/objectui` / `PM_SWEEP_REPO`; the two objectui-only switches are DROPPED, ⛔ not upstreamed — ruled here on the reading: `PM_SWEEP_CLOSED_WINDOW_PAGES` survives on `origin/main` `0cf2d6644bdb` only in commented-out lines of `.github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml` (an escape hatch that expired 2026-08-28) and in the port's own tests; `closedWindowDisabled` only in those tests (`scripts/__tests__/check-half-states.test.ts`), which are deleted with the port. ② `.claude/hooks/*` (8 files) — kept as plain copies the harness loads, one header line `copied from objectstack@<sha>`, no ledger, no parity check. ③ `board-snapshot.yml` — as ②, or a step calling the objectstack script. Then `upstream-port-pin.json`, `check-upstream-port-parity.mjs`, `--resync`, self-test, script entry and workflow step are deleted. Net −13 pins, −123 divergences, −1 gate; the accepted cost is that hook drift is found by hand.

**State in this stroke:** closed `not_planned`; `needs-user-decision` removed.
